prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A man with a large, voluminous afro hairstyle stands next to a sleek, black modern sedan, likely a Ford Fusion, in a minimalist studio setting. The man is positioned to the right of the car, facing the camera, and is mid-gesture, holding up a set of car keys in one hand with a casual, slightly playful demeanor. He wears a colorful, patterned sweater with abstract designs, dark cropped pants, and black shoes, giving him a quirky, creative appearance. The background is a seamless, clean white, creating a high-key, commercial look that draws all attention to the subjects. The lighting is soft and even, eliminating harsh shadows and emphasizing the glossy finish of the car and the texture of the man's hair. The composition is balanced, with the car occupying the left and center of the frame and the man providing visual interest on the right. The overall style is crisp, contemporary, and slightly humorous, reminiscent of a modern advertisement or promotional shoot, with a focus on clarity, personality, and product presentation.
